query:
select c.id, coalesce(c.book_slot, case c.kind when 'oil' then 'oil' when 'filter' then 'oil_filter' else 'none' end) as "book_slot!", c.book_interval_km, c.book_interval_days
           from categories c
           where coalesce(c.book_slot, case c.kind when 'oil' then 'oil' when 'filter' then 'oil_filter' else 'none' end) <> 'none' order by c.name
